name: Hyperdrive Connection Pooling D1 Teljesítményhez
description: Hyperdrive connection pooling D1 teljesítmény javításhoz. Opcionális - csak ha D1 query latency probléma jelentkezik.
archiveReason: Hyperdrive is designed for external PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, not for Cloudflare D1. D1 is a native Cloudflare database that is already optimized for Workers and does not support Hyperdrive connection pooling.
